newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks end mixed, main index slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks end mixed, main index slightly lower.

text.p: Manila stocks ended mixed on Friday, with speculative issues attracting buyers, as most foreign investors stayed on the sidelines, brokers said.

"Small cap issues were the main play of the day for local investors. There's not much action from foreigners who are still contemplating on where to invest more funds-in the west or in Asia," said Monique Lecaros, analyst at Armstrong Securities.
The 30-share composite index slipped by 0.02 points to 3,062.1. But gainers outnumbered losers 60 to 56, with the prices of 67 issues remaining unchanged.

Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities, said there was brisk buying on bargain small-cap issues like industrial estate developer MRC Allied, milk maker Alaska, Philippine Realty Holdings and packaging firm Steniel Manufacturing.

"These issues are currently priced below 10 times their projected earnings in 1997 so local investors picked them up," he said. Brokers said they see the main index testing the 3,100 barrier next week. - DOLLY AGLAY 63 2 841-8937
